headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals continue their winning streak, while the Houston Astros secure a shutout victory. Injuries are piling up across the league, and teams are making roster moves to bolster their lineups.

The top MLB news of the day features the Cardinals' 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, led by Jordan Walker's home run and three RBIs. In a contrasting matchup, the Reds edged out the Cardinals 7-6 in a thrilling finish, with Jordan Walker again leading the Cardinals' offense. The Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs 3-0, with Christian Walker contributing a 3-for-3 performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tampa Bay Rays right fielder Jonny DeLuca, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Detroit Tigers left-hander Brant Hurter, Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr., and Chicago White Sox right-hander Jordan Hicks.

The Philadelphia Phillies made a roster move, trading right-hander Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money. The Cincinnati Reds also made a trade, sending right fielder Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins in exchange for right-hander Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded left-hander Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for third baseman Oliver Dunn, while the Toronto Blue Jays traded left-hander Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-for-3 performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, securing a win on the road. Patrick Corbin led the Blue Jays' pitching effort with 6.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rays Place RF Jonny DeLuca on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right fielder Jonny DeLuca has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to May 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
